title: A return on an old invoice counts this month and never moves a past month
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'See Financial Data' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Use staging, where Part Sales invoiced before the release are kept.
  • Have a Part Sale on staging invoiced before the release (last month or earlier) with a part line that can still be returned, for a customer you note as customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  3. Pick the month of that Part Sale's invoice in the Date filter.
  4. Note the Before tiers row's Parts Invoiced and Parts Credits.
  5. Return the part line from that Part Sale with no restocking fee.
  6. Pick This month in the Date filter.
  7. Pick the month of the Part Sale's invoice again in the Date filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens on this month.

Step 2:

  • The Customer chip shows customer A.

Step 3:

  • The old month shows a Before tiers row.

Step 4:

  • Both figures are noted.

Step 5:

  • A credit for the return is made today.

Step 6:

  • This month shows a Before tiers row with the return's credit as a negative Parts Credits figure.

Step 7:

  • The old month's Before tiers row shows the same Parts Invoiced and Parts Credits as noted.
  • No new credit shows in that month.
